description: Hosted MCP server for the APITube News API: real-time and archived news search across 500,000+ sources, 177 countries and 59 languages, with sentiment scores and named entities on every article.

commands: claude mcp add --transport http apitube-news https://mcp.apitube.io/ --header "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"

notes: Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>, or X-API-Key: <API_KEY>. Keys come from apitube.io.
initialize, tools/list and prompts/list answer without a key; search_news and suggest require a paid-plan key (Starter and up, free tier is REST-only).

Submitted by the vendor. Anyone can check the server without a key: curl -X POST https://mcp.apitube.io/ -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list"}' returns search_news and suggest.
initialize reports server APITube News MCP-Server 1.0.0, protocol 2025-11-25 negotiated down to the client version (2024-11-05 works), capabilities tools and prompts.
Listed in the official MCP registry as io.apitube/news.
